PreToolUse.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command $input | ConvertFrom-Json | & { param($data) if ($data.toolName -eq 'execute' -or $data.toolName -eq 'run_in_terminal') { $cmd = $data.toolInput.command; if ($cmd -match '(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|DELETE\s+FROM\s+\w+\s*;|DELETE\s+FROM\s+\w+\s*$|RESET\s+(DATABASE|SEQUENCE)|ALTER\s+TABLE.*DROP\s+COLUMN|supabase\s+(reset|db\s+reset)|dropdb|destroydb)' -and $cmd -notmatch 'WHERE' ) { @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'deny'; permissionDecisionReason = 'BLOCKED: Destructive database operation detected (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without WHERE, RESET). Database schemas and data are protected. All modifications require explicit approval.' } } | ConvertTo-Json } else { @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'allow' } } | ConvertTo-Json } } else { @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'allow' } } | ConvertTo-Json }
